# Research Vocabulary

## Terms

This note lists customer learning, discovery language, interviews, assumptions, experiments, uncertainty, evidence, and common words used in product research conversations. It exists so a team can align on what those terms mean in planning documents, workshop notes, and status updates.

## Reference Usage

The note is intentionally reference-oriented. It defines phrases such as hypothesis, signal, problem framing, opportunity, validation, and experiment design. It may resemble a discovery guide lexically, but it does not explain the working loop that turns uncertainty into the next product decision.

## Scope Boundary

Use this note when the task is to align vocabulary or compare wording. Do not use it as the main guide for deciding how interviews, evidence gathering, and small tests should reduce uncertainty before expanding a solution.
